messages:
maria: Quick heads-up — code freeze goes into effect in ~48h (EOD Friday). Please avoid non-critical merges. If you need a hotpatch, request a short exception here with a clear risk note and rollback plan.

ash: Noted. I'm about to push a bump for 2.7.1 (changelog only). Is that allowed?

maria: @ash changelog-only bumps are fine if they don't touch compiled artifacts. Add the 'changelog' label and self-merge after CI passes.

sam: FWIW I found a serialization edge-case in embeddings that breaks some customers — PR #7822. It's small but risky. Can I get an exception to land a targeted fix + smoke tests?

leo: Can you summarize the user-facing impact and the delta in risk? We need a brief risk assessment for the exception log.

sam: Impact: intermittent incorrect vector ordering for long texts (>8k tokens) — rare but causing mis-reranks. Fix: one-line change in kv-serializer + unit + integration test. Delta: low LOC, touches core codec. Rollback: revert PR, redeploy previous model variant.

olivia: @sam please add the following to the PR description: risk assessment (2-3 bullets), which customers could be affected, and the rollback steps. Also tag @qa-squad and add a smoke test checklist.

sam: Doing that now. Cherry-pick snippet for anyone who needs it: ```git fetch origin main && git checkout -b hotfix/kv-serial && git cherry-pick abc1234 && git push origin hotfix/kv-serial```

jen: QA: we can run the smoke suite in staging and a focused load test for the kv path. ETA ~2 hours once PR is merged into a hotfix branch.

maria: Ops note: if approved, we expect a maintenance window ~30m during the hotpatch rollout. @release-bot will post the checkpoint when we start. Please ensure you add the label 'release/exception' and 'risk/high' or 'risk/low' accordingly.

ash: One question — if the fix touches runtime kernels, do we still allow exception? The PR looks like it only affects serialization, not kernels.

leo: If it doesn't change kernels or runtime artifacts, it's fine. If it requires model recompile/weights change, no exception in freeze window.

sam: Confirmed: pure Python/serde change, no kernels. Marking 'risk/low' and adding the smoke checklist. PR: https://git.internal/redwood/pr/7822

olivia: @sam add a changelog blurb too (short): "Fix: embeddings ordering for long texts". We'll include it in the 2.7.1 notes.

maria: OK — provisional approval from me. @jen after QA sign-off, coordinate the deploy and post the exact maintenance start in this thread.

jen: Will do. I'll kick off tests after merge and update here with timestamps and observed failures.

release-bot: Deploy cue noted. Remember to append the exception form: `https://infra.redwood/tools/release-exception?pr=7822&owner=sam`

sam: Uploaded the risk doc, smoke checklist, and changelog entry. Pushed hotfix branch and requested review from @leo and @olivia.

leo: Reviewing now. Small nit in the test — suggest one more assertion around order stability, otherwise LGTM.

olivia: Approved from docs perspective. Changelog entry looks good.

jen: QA run started (1723457005). Running minimal load scenario then integration smoke. Will report pass/fail here.

jen: QA: smoke suite PASS, focused load PASS (observed 0 failures at target qps). (1723457120)

maria: Thanks team. Rolling this through the hotpatch window in ~10m. I'll mark final approval. Please be on-call for 30m post-deploy.

release-bot: Maintenance window started (1723457185). Posting status updates to #status and paging oncall.

sam: Deployed and verified basic sanity checks. No errors in logs now.

jen: Post-deploy checks clear. No regressions observed in canary. (1723457200)

maria: Closing exception. Add final changelog note that this was a hotpatch during freeze. Thanks everyone :tada:
